title: 第1354章 看守第1353章 庙门危机
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
林凡眼神一沉。
这不是提示别人。
是给所有听见的人看的。
别应。
四目道长道：“这玩意真会装。”
林凡道：“不是装。”
“它知道自己要靠应声进。”
“所以反过来提醒你别应。”
顾安道：“它在试你们会不会把它当提醒。”
九叔冷声道：“那就不把它当。”
“继续压。”
他已经看出来了。
现在不是和口路比谁会说。
而是看谁先稳住。
黑水集土地庙里传出的喊声，越急，说明它越想开口。
它开不了。
所以才会换名、换声、换提醒。
这已经说明，裂缝下的东西，急了。
林凡心里判断。
“师叔。”

“不要再让梁头开口。”
“让他坐远一点。”
“把本地人分开。”
“一人一句，压三轮。”
四目道：“明白。”
梁头和本地人开始轮流说。
“此地无灯。”
“此地无灯。”
“此地无灯。”
第一轮后，庙声降了一截。
第二轮后，裂缝里的红边开始往回缩。
第三轮后，黑纸边缘终于不再抬起。
四目道长压低声音。
“有效。”
林凡道：“继续到天亮。”
“不要停。”
“中间谁都不能换气太久。”
“也别让人乱问。”
content_en:
Lin Fan's eyes darkened.
This is not a reminder to others.
It is for all who hear it.
Don't respond.
The four-eyed Taoist priest said: "This thing is really good at pretending."
Lin Fan said: "It's not pretending."
"It knows it has to rely on the response."
"So I'll remind you not to respond."
Gu An said: "It's testing whether you will take it as a reminder."
Uncle Jiu said coldly: "Then don't take it seriously."
"Keep pressing."
He has seen it.
Now it’s not about comparing who can speak with Kou Lu.
It's about who can stabilize first.
The more urgent the shouts coming from the Tutu Temple in Heishuiji, the more eager it is to speak.
It won't open.
That’s why I changed my name, voice, and reminder.
This already shows that the things under the cracks are urgent.
Lin Fan judged in his mind.
"Uncle Master."
"Don't let Liang Tou speak again."
"Let him sit further away."
"Separate the natives."
"One word per person, three rounds of pressure."
Four eyes said: "Understood."
Liang Tou and the locals began to take turns talking.
"There are no lights here."
"There are no lights here."
"There are no lights here."
After the first round, the temple's voice dropped a bit.
After the second round, the red edge in the crack began to shrink.
After the third round, the edge of the black paper finally stopped lifting.
Taoist priest Simu lowered his voice.
"It works."
Lin Fan said: "Continue until dawn."
"Don't stop."
"No one can take a breath for too long in the middle."
"Don't let people ask random questions."
